cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the refund. I said this holiday would have a sunny ending, and a cheque will brighten things up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said sunny weather. We spent a week indoors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why we're getting the money back. Give me the receipts; I'll make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You booked it. You explain why we packed sunglasses for a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell them I chose the dates. When the cheque comes, I want you to remember who forecast a sunny ending.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads refund recovery and changes sunny from weather to financial relief; A3 treats rain as the route to that outcome; A5 accepts accountability while claiming prediction credit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rainy failure causes A3 refund reasoning; B4 personal responsibility causes A5 naming A chosen dates before seeking remembered forecast.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants the booking decision-maker to do the explanation and actual recovery work.

heightening.evidence: A5 preserves A certainty while taking the exposure B4 demands to keep B involved in the refund effort.

specificity.evidence: A1 prospective cheque, B2 ruined weather and B4 flood all concern one holiday outcome.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 factual responsibility statement and direct credit request replace the unsupported bright-smile image.
